当应用需要在界面上展示地图并进行交互操作时使用本Kit，典型场景包括地图导航、周边服务查找、位置标注、轨迹展示、区域划分可视化等
MapComponent组件提供了完整的地图UI能力，支持深色模式、室内图、3D地球等多种展示效果
当应用需要实现位置搜索或路径规划功能时使用本Kit
支持关键字搜索、周边搜索、自动补全等POI搜索能力，以及驾车、步行、骑行和公共交通四种出行方式的路径规划
驾车路径规划支持途经点和多种路线偏好
当需要使用地点选取、地点详情展示、区划选择等场景化控件，或需要获取静态地图图片、调用花瓣地图应用实现导航时，也可使用Map Kit提供的相关能力
在页面中嵌入交互式地图并支持缩放拖动 / Embed an interactive map view with zoom and pan support
显示当前定位并让地图跟随用户位置移动 / Show current location and keep the map centered on the user
在地图上绘制轨迹路线和运动路径回放 / Draw trip tracks on the map and replay movement routes
添加自定义标注气泡和点击地图点位事件 / Add custom map markers with callouts and handle map tap events
按关键词搜索附近餐厅商场医院等地点 / Search nearby places like restaurants, malls, and hospitals by keyword
根据起点终点生成导航路线并展示距离时间 / Generate routes between origin and destination and show distance and duration
把经纬度解析成详细地址并显示城市街道信息 / Resolve latitude and longitude into a full address with city and street info
把用户输入的地址转换为地图坐标并定位到该位置 / Convert a typed address into map coordinates and move the map to it
在地图上展示热力图聚合点和海量点图层 / Display heatmaps, clustered markers, and massive point layers on the map
限制地图可视区域并设置初始中心点和缩放级别 / Restrict the visible map region and set initial center and zoom level
显示多个门店网点位置并支持一键查看最近门店 / Show multiple store locations and let users find the nearest branch
叠加圆形围栏多边形区域和折线边界范围 / Overlay circles, polygons, and polylines to mark geofences or boundaries
do_not_use_when: 需求是订阅加速度计、陀螺仪、磁力计、气压计等本地或动态传感器数据，或控制设备振动反馈；应改用 sensor-service-kit / The requirement is to subscribe to accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer, barometer, or other local/dynamic sensor data, or control vibrator feedback; use sensor-service-kit instead

需求是开发USB、HID、Serial、SCSI等外设驱动，处理即插即用或专业办公/医疗设备接入；应改用 driver-development-kit / The requirement is to develop drivers for USB, HID, Serial, or SCSI peripherals, handling plug-and-play or professional office/medical device integration; use driver-development-kit instead

需求是连接和控制云台等机械设备，执行人脸/物体目标追踪、跟踪布局或蓝牙精准角度运动控制；应改用 mechanic-kit / The requirement is to connect to and control gimbals or other mechanical devices for face/object target tracking, tracking layouts, or precise Bluetooth angle and motion control; use mechanic-kit instead

需求是实现手机与穿戴设备之间的消息通信、通知推送、设备状态监控、文件传输或读取穿戴侧传感数据；应改用 wear-engine-kit / The requirement is to enable phone-to-wearable message communication, notification push, device status monitoring, file transfer, or reading wearable-side sensor data; use wear-engine-kit instead

需求是对接运动健康开放数据，读取日常活动、锻炼记录、健康指标或实时生理数据；应改用 health-service-kit / The requirement is to integrate with the fitness and health data platform for daily activity, workout records, health metrics, or real-time physiological data; use health-service-kit instead
preconditions: 工程已集成并启用 Map Kit 能力，且应用已完成地图服务相关配置 / The project has integrated and enabled Map Kit capabilities, and the app has completed the required map service configuration
设备网络可用，能够访问地图、搜索或路径规划服务 / Network connectivity is available so the device can reach map, search, or routing services
若要显示“我的位置”或基于当前位置搜索，module.json5 已声明定位权限且用户已授权 / If showing “my location” or searching based on current position, location permissions are declared in module.json5 and granted by the user
inputs: 地图组件或地图控制器对象 / map component or map controller object
坐标、地址、关键字或POI查询参数 / coordinates, address, keyword, or POI query parameters
起点、终点、途经点及出行方式等路径规划参数 / origin, destination, waypoint, and travel mode routing parameters

postconditions.statement: 代码中已接入地图显示、地图搜索/编码或路径规划中的至少一种 Map Kit 能力 / The code integrates at least one Map Kit capability among map display, map search/geocoding, or route planning
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set add or modify HarmonyOS code/configuration that clearly uses Map Kit APIs or components for map rendering, POI/geocoding, or route planning?

postconditions.statement: 若需求涉及地图界面，已新增或配置可展示地图的组件并绑定必要参数 / If the requirement involves a map UI, a component capable of displaying a map has been added or configured with necessary parameters
postconditions.judge_prompt: If the requested task involves showing a map, do the edits add or configure a map UI component or its initialization logic rather than only unrelated business code?

postconditions.statement: 若需求涉及当前位置展示，已同时体现定位权限或定位数据接入与地图展示的衔接 / If the requirement involves showing current location, the edits reflect both location permission/data hookup and its integration with the map display
postconditions.judge_prompt: When the task mentions showing the user's current location, do the edits include both location-related setup/usage and code that applies that location to the map?
